'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[cruise missile]] and [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]]. Among the targets hit is an [[industrial park|industrial zone]] in [[Pavlohrad]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], where a large [[explosion]] damaged or destroyed 19 apartment buildings and 25 homes, with 34 people reportedly injured. [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] say that they shot down 15 of 18 missiles launched by Russia. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/may/01/ukraine-ammunition-depot-reportedly-hit-in-wave-of-russian-missile-attacks (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***Ukrainian [[colonel general]] [[Oleksandr Syrskyi]] says that [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] have recaptured parts of central [[Bakhmut]], but that the situation on the ground "remains difficult". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-defenders-oust-russian-forces-some-positions-bakhmut-ukraine-general-2023-05-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**Fifteen people are killed after unidentified gunmen open fire at a farm in [[Kérou]], [[Benin]]. [https://apnews.com/article/benin-killings-farm-attack-6a977fbb32955de6b0f7ca4126c6ef29 (Associated Press)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A 17-year-old [[Palestinian]] boy is killed during an [[Israel]]i raid near [[Jericho]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-teen-killed-west-bank-a434b00ac19b049747cd3ccee72ee379 (Associated Press)]
*A bomb is [[detonate]]d on the road between [[Sofia]] and [[Samokov]], [[Bulgaria]]. The target is believed to be the Chief Public Prosecutor of Bulgaria [[Ivan Geshev]], whose motorcade was travelling on the road at the time. No injuries are reported. The explosion has been designated as a [[terrorist]] incident by officials. [https://www.politico.eu/article/bulgaria-prosecutor-escapes-bombing-attempt-officials-say/ (''Politico Europe'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 global banking crisis]]
**The [[Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation|FDIC]] seizes control of [[First Republic Bank]], while [[JPMorgan Chase]] agrees to buy "a substantial majority of assets" and to assume the "deposits and certain other liabilities" of the bank, in the [[List of largest bank failures in the United States|second-largest]] [[bank failure]] in US history. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/01/business/first-republic-purchase-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed, one person is injured, and another person is reported missing in an explosion at a [[chemical plant]] in [[Liaocheng]], [[Shandong]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/five-killed-sinochem-chemical-plant-shandong-province-2023-05-01/ (Reuters)]
*At least six people are killed and 30 others are injured in [[Illinois]], [[United States]], after a [[dust storm]] causes a crash involving 70 to 90 vehicles on [[Interstate 55]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/01/us/illinois-dust-storm-crashes/index.html (CNN)]
*The oil tanker MT Pablo catches fire off the coast of [[Malaysia]] with three of five crew members missing afterward.  The tanker was reportedly carrying sanctioned oil and had changed flags only six days earlier.  Oil washes up on the shores of [[Indonesia]] later. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/01/asia/malaysia-coast-oil-tanker-fire-rescue-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://lloydslist.maritimeintelligence.informa.com/LL1144944/Dark-fleet-tanker-Pablo-changed-flags-six-days-before-fatal-casualty (''Lloyd's List'')] [https://www.qcintel.com/article/oil-from-pablo-tanker-explosion-washes-up-on-indonesian-coastline-13626.html (Quantum Commodity Intelligence)]
*a [[Cessna 206]] light aircraft with seven people on board [[2023 Colombia Cessna 206 crash|crashed in the jungle]] in the [[Caquetá Department]] of Colombia.[https://bnn.network/breaking-news/authorities-coordinate-search-efforts-for-missing-c206-plane-with-seven-occupants/ BNN]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Paraguayan general election]]
**[[Santiago Peña]] is declared the winner of the [[Paraguayan president]]ial election. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-65445154 (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Salvadoran general election]], [[Salvadoran gang crackdown (2022–present)]]
**Various Salvadoran trade unions, syndicates, and political parties held a [[2023 Salvadoran protests|protest march]] demanding an increase in wages and against presidential re-election and the ongoing gang crackdown. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/bukele-s-popularity-soars-with-controversial-approach-to-crime/ar-AA1aUwPW (MSN)] [https://nacla.org/el-salvador-surfing-new-land-free (North American Congress on Latin America)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 World Snooker Championship]]
**[[Luca Brecel]] wins his first [[World Snooker Championship]] title, defeating [[Mark Selby]] by a score of 18–15 in the final at [[Crucible Theatre|The Crucible]] in [[Sheffield]], [[England]]. Brecel becomes the first player from [[continental Europe]] to win the tournament. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/av/snooker/65443284 (BBC Sport)]
